thesis: PRE-CLOSE (15:00 ET) read on Thursday 2026-08-20, positioning into the close and overnight. The session that opened down has now TRENDED down: intraday-tape-lab reads a Trend day (down auction) under Mixed control with VWAP 766.02, gap -0.41% and 62 bars, and SPY has slid from the completed 8/19 close (769.06) and the morning 766.08 to 763.54 (spot 763.65), now BELOW its VWAP and sagging toward the 760 put wall. Structure first, and the multi-month frame is still intact: SPY 763.54 keeps its deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked), +1.71% over its 50-day (~750.7) and +8.37% over its 200-day (~704.6), mom126/252 +12.14%/+20.66%, pctFrom52wHigh -1.84, so price is roughly 1.8% under the highs rather than a break, though swing-structure-lab still qualifies a Double top pattern and reads its own trend regime as unknown. What DEEPENED into the close and matters for the overnight plan: the dealer map got MORE negative and the walls dropped under the spot. options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab (spot 763.65) read SPY in negative dealer gamma with the flip 768.74, the call wall 765 and the put wall 760, and SPY 763.65 has fallen below the 765 call wall into the 760/765 pocket, signed net GEX -6.86B (materially more negative than the -5.22B at the morning read), the front expected move ±4.41 and atmIV 15.61%, so below the flip dealers amplify and the 760 put wall is the line into the close. VIX held a calm 16.0 (band VIX 16.0), essentially flat versus the morning 16.01 and well under the 20 handle and the +3 single-reference regime-change threshold, with the deterministic composite score 0, VIX-only (Fear & Greed not fetched). options-flow-feed-lab turned decisively PUT-HEAVY (leaning bearish/hedged): callFraction 0.3093, call premium $962.5M against put premium $2.149B across 12 tickers with 1532 contracts clearing the $250k bar, and the most-unusual print is a SPY 766 PUT at $150.6M on 136.2x open interest (0DTE), with an IWM 298 PUT and a TSLA 340 PUT ($27.4M) also bid. The near-term leaders slid further and XLK lost its line: SPMO 147.75 is now -1.98% below its 50-day (~150.7, mom5 -3.25, mom21 -1.55) while holding +13.13% over its 200-day (~130.6), QQQ 709.17 is -0.52% below its 50-day (~713, mom5 -3.13, tangled) and XLK 182.85 has slipped back onto its 50-day (~182.9, -0.01%). What did NOT confirm and keeps the beta add's remaining tranches gated: counting persistence by distinct market-bar dates, only the most recent completed bar (8/19) clears the line, market-heatmap-lab reads breadth 64.33% of 134 (broad, margin +4.33), with 26.1% on 8/17 and 55.23% on 8/18, so three-bar persistence above 60% is still not established. Structure first, tactical noise last: hold the intact structural core and the first beta-add tranche while pausing the rest, tilt the sector book toward the Leading energy/healthcare (XLE/XLV) and Improving defensives (XLU/XLP) funded from weakening financials (XLF), hold (not chase) MSFT, and carry a SMALL overnight tail whose case strengthened again, adding on a close that loses the 760 put wall.
